method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, version in force from 1/4/2022 (SSO, in force as at 2026-09-30)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: The passenger's seat: Art 1 and s 10 (does the Convention govern the journey), Arts 17 to 21 with ss 5 and 9 (liability), Arts 3, 4, 22 and 25 with s 6(1) (limits and their loss), Art 22(4) (costs), Art 23, Art 25A, Art 26 with s 7 (complaints), Art 29 with s 8(1), (4) (two years), Art 28 (where to sue), Art 30 (successive carriers), in each of the three Schedules; cargo, air waybills, postal and State carriage, the treaty machinery and franc conversion not encoded
